---
crossref:
  chapters: true
  fig-title: "Figura"
listing:
  - id: alpha
    type: default
mermaid:
  theme: dark
editor:
  mode: visual
chalkboard:
  theme: whiteboard
lightbox:
  effect: fade
grid:
  sidebar-width: 250px
about:
  template: jolla
  image-shape: round
---

Every value here renders exit 0 under `quarto render` 1.7.33 (grounded firsthand as one
document, Session 132), so the feature must produce ZERO diagnostics:

- `crossref.chapters: true` — valid closed boolean.
- `crossref.fig-title: "Figura"` — an OPEN string child (the parser leaves it open) → never
  flagged. The standing FP guard for a recognized-but-open container child.
- `listing:` as a SEQUENCE — the `- id: alpha` sequence item makes `mappingContainerKey`
  return null, so `nestedParentPath` bails and the `type: default` under it is NOT reached
  (a documented safe false negative, plan §2.3; the single-object `listing:` form IS
  validated, exercised in `container-values.qmd`).
- `mermaid.theme: dark` / `editor.mode: visual` / `chalkboard.theme: whiteboard` /
  `lightbox.effect: fade` — valid closed enum members (the regression guard that valid
  closed values are NOT flagged).
- `grid.sidebar-width: 250px` — a mixed `anyOf[number, string]` dimension → OPEN (`number &&
  !other` fails); quarto accepts `"250px"`, so we correctly stay silent (same mechanism as
  the numeric slice's `linestretch: 2em`).
- `about:` WITH the REQUIRED `template` (else quarto exit 1 on a missing-property error, NOT
  a value error the feature flags) + `image-shape: round` — a valid closed enum member.
